tickets.title: Repository and toolchain

tickets.title: Configuration and secrets
tickets.implementation: Typed environment schema, secret references and invalid-config startup failure.
tickets.evidence: Strict configuration validator added; secret-free local validation passed.

tickets.title: Database and migrations
tickets.implementation: Roles, migration runner/checksum/lock and clean/upgrade verification.

tickets.title: Identity integration
tickets.implementation: OIDC BFF session and scoped API identity with no browser token persistence.

tickets.title: CI quality gates

tickets.title: Demo deployment isolation
tickets.implementation: Separate demo DB/storage/mail adapters and prohibited production fixture registration.
tickets.note: Supabase demo schema is live; local seed remains demo-mode guarded.
tickets.evidence: Supabase lara_api read succeeded; schema mutation was denied.

tickets.title: Observability and readiness

tickets.title: Backup and engineering release
